definition: per (arch, recipe_actual) cell — cell identity from the RESOLVED training config, never a directory name (see results/notes/recipe_erratum.md): tau = median over images of (median(v_i) + k*MAD(v_i)) on last_block_patch_norms of the cell's designated baseline last checkpoint (the seeded s1 baseline when one exists, else the legacy designated baseline), k=5.0; all medians are LOWER medians, matching torch.median as used by saga.metrics.sink_counts_mad
